defect: Upload and streaming caps count everything that ever happened in the runtime: 128 v1 and 8 v2 receipts ever, 512 MiB / 7 GiB reserved by every receipt not aborted (retained included), and 128 streaming imports ever. Rehearsals spend them and the live drop gets 429.

change.why: create() quota: count open receipts (receiving, finalizing or aborting, and before expiry, under a live lease, or with a v2 job to finish it) and the bytes they reserve, per case, per operator subject and runtime-wide; drop the lifetime receipt count; add the per-case retained-bytes ceiling; configured v2 capacity counts what is on disk now; 429 words name the limit and when a slot frees. finalize() untouched (ZL2).

STREAMING_HISTORY_CAPACITY: 128 imports per case instead of 128 ever in the runtime; the large GeoJSON intake path (intake-large-worker.ts) enqueues through this reader, so it consumed the runtime-wide count. 2 active stays; 429 words say when a slot frees.
Drop maxUploadReceipts (a lifetime count no longer enforced) from both limit objects; comment what maxReservedOriginalBytes now bounds.
Regenerated: the limits endpoint publishes the limit objects.
Pure tests of the quota decision and words; the in-memory pool answers the new quota statement.

reuse: The existing admission advisory lock and the one quota statement in create()
AppError details through the existing exception filter
Existing limit constants; no new numbers

decisions.D2: Per-case ceiling = maxReservedOriginalBytes of the receipt's profile (512 MiB v1, 7 GiB v2), counted over retained originals plus open receipts of that profile in the case plus the new request.
decisions.D3: No sweeper exists for expired receipts (grep: nothing outside large-original.ts reads usp_source_uploads.expires_at), so the check skips them; their remaining temporary part bytes still count against the configured physical capacity.

seamsOutside: None. intake-zip-layers.ts reads only the UPLOAD_QUOTA code, which stays. No runtime, Docker, GPU or provider.
